name: cognee-memory
description: Cognee knowledge graph memory for Grok Bot — remember, recall and forget against your Cognee server over MCP, with skills that teach the agent when to store and when to search.

COGNEE_MCP_URL.title: Cognee MCP endpoint
COGNEE_MCP_URL.description: Public HTTPS URL of a cognee-mcp server running with --transport http (for example https://memory.example.com/mcp). Grok Bot runs in the cloud and cannot reach localhost or private addresses.

COGNEE_API_KEY.title: Cognee API key
COGNEE_API_KEY.description: Optional. Sent as the X-Api-Key header; only used by endpoints that authenticate per request.
